Vacancy.title: Vacancy
Vacancy.description: A job vacancy (vacature) published by the employer. Models the ADR-001 menu-6 'Onboarding & ATS' recruiting surface (recruiting-ats-basic): a declarative concept -> gepubliceerd -> gesloten publish lifecycle. HR ticks the job boards in channels; the shipped flows Vacature plaatsen and Vacature intrekken post the vacancy to each board through integriq when it is published and withdraw it when it closes, one VacancyPosting per board (hiring-multiposting). portaliq publishes the vacancies with status gepubliceerd on a public careers page through humaniq's candidate audience (hiring-portal-audiences). Applications reference this Vacancy via Application.vacancyId.

search.description: Search published job vacancies (vacatures) by status, or by the department that owns them. Use this to answer which roles are currently open, what a department is recruiting for, or which vacancies have closed. Returns the posting only: it holds no candidate or applicant data, which is deliberately not exposed here.

get.description: Get one job vacancy in full: title, description, owning department, status, and its published and closing dates. Use it after a search to read the posting text itself. No applicant is reachable from it.

publiceren.description: The vacancy is published. PublishedDate is stamped on the carrying write (the Timesheet approvedAt/approvedBy pattern). Once an administrator enables the Vacature plaatsen flow, publishing also posts the vacancy to every board in channels (hiring-multiposting D1).

sluiten.description: The vacancy is closed. Terminal: no re-open and no publish-from-closed edge; a closed vacancy is re-created, not resurrected. Once an administrator enables the Vacature intrekken flow, closing withdraws every live posting (hiring-multiposting D1).

x-openregister-flows.name: Vacature plaatsen
x-openregister-flows.description: Posts a vacancy to every job board ticked in channels when it is published, and records one Vacancy posting per board: posted with the board's reference and link, or failed with the reason. A failed board does not stop the others, and a board with no branch in this flow is recorded as failed with no source configured. The flow arrives disabled. Before enabling it: in integriq, create a source and a mapping per board named after its code (werk-nl, linkedin, indeed; mapping humaniq-vacancy-<code>), set each post step's endpoint and responseMapping to that board's API, and delete the branch of a board you do not use (hiring-multiposting D1, D2, D4).

x-openregister-flows.name: Vacature intrekken
x-openregister-flows.description: Withdraws a closed vacancy from every job board it is live on, and marks each posting withdrawn with the moment. A board that refuses keeps its posting as posted, with the reason in the last error. The flow arrives disabled. Enable it together with Vacature plaatsen, after setting each withdraw step's endpoint to that board's API (hiring-multiposting D1, D4).

title.title: Title
title.description: The job title as it appears in the advert.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department or team the vacancy belongs to.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this vacancy has got to: draft, published or closed.
status.x-notes: Publish workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (concept -> gepubliceerd -> gesloten).

publishedDate.title: Published date
publishedDate.x-notes: Date the vacancy was published, stamped on the publiceren carrying write.

closingDate.title: Closing date
closingDate.description: The application deadline. For information only: it does not close the vacancy by itself.
closingDate.x-notes: Application deadline. Informational only in the MVP — it does not drive the sluiten transition.

formatieplaatsId.title: Formation place
formatieplaatsId.description: The formation place this vacancy recruits for. Leave empty for a vacancy outside the formation.
formatieplaatsId.x-notes: people-formation-positions D1: links recruitment to the budget it fills; the hire's contract names the same place.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this vacancy belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this Vacancy is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); a vacancy has no employee to derive it from, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema.

questions.title: Application questions
questions.description: Your own questions on the application form for this vacancy, such as whether the candidate has a driving licence.
questions.x-notes: hiring-portal-audiences D3: the manifest fields[] shape CnFormBuilder writes. Answers land on job-application.answers keyed by question key.

key.title: Key
key.description: A short name the answer is stored under.

type.title: Answer type
type.description: The kind of answer: a line of text, longer text, a choice, a number or a date.

label.title: Question
label.description: The question as the candidate reads it.

placeholder.title: Placeholder
placeholder.description: An example answer shown in the empty field.

required.title: Required
required.description: The candidate must answer before applying.

options.title: Choices
options.description: The answers a candidate can pick from, for a choice.

channels.title: Job boards
channels.description: The job boards this vacancy is posted to when it is published, such as werk-nl, linkedin or indeed.
channels.x-notes: hiring-multiposting D2: each code is the name of the integriq source (and mapping) the board is reached through. No enum: which boards exist is integriq configuration.

postedToChannels.title: Posted to the job boards
postedToChannels.description: Set when the vacancy has been sent to its job boards, so a later save does not post it again.
postedToChannels.x-notes: hiring-multiposting D3: written by the Vacature plaatsen flow before it posts. Clear it to post the vacancy again; postings are updated, not duplicated.

job-application.title: Application
job-application.description: A candidate's application (sollicitatie) against a Vacancy. Candidate PII (name/email/phone/CV/motivation) lives DIRECTLY on this object: there is deliberately no separate Candidate entity in the MVP (AVG data-minimisation, design D2): one object carries one retention clock (retentionExpiryDate) and one deletion (deleting the Application deletes the candidate's data atomically). The declarative pipeline lifecycle runs nieuw -> screening -> gesprek -> aanbod -> aangenomen, with afwijzen reachable from every active stage. Rejecting an application stamps rejectedDate and derives retentionExpiryDate per the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn (4 weeks, or 1 year with explicit talentPoolOptIn consent). Enforced by the nl-ats-retentie-derivatie and nl-ats-retentie-verlopen checks (lib/Standards/Checks/NlAtsChecks.php, lib/Standards/rules/privacy.json). Aannemen documents a MANUAL onboarding hand-off (creating the Employee from this data is a manual follow-up action in the MVP. No cross-object write hook).

uitnodigen.description: The candidate is invited for an interview. No calendar/scheduling integration in the MVP.

aanbieden.description: An offer is extended to the candidate. No offer-letter generation/e-signature in the MVP.

aannemen.description: The candidate is hired. Terminal. Onboarding hand-off is a MANUAL follow-up action in the MVP: HR creates the Employee/Onboarding case by hand from this application's data (the same deferral class as leave-balance auto-posting); no cross-object write hook fires here.

afwijzen.description: The candidate is rejected, or HR records a candidate's withdrawal this way. Terminal. rejectedDate and retentionExpiryDate are stamped on the carrying write: retentionExpiryDate = rejectedDate + 4 weeks, or + 1 year with talentPoolOptIn consent (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn).

vacancyId.title: Vacancy
vacancyId.description: The vacancy this application is for.
vacancyId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Vacancy this application is for.

candidateName.title: Candidate name
candidateName.description: The candidate's full name. Their personal data lives only on this record: deleting it deletes the data.
candidateName.x-notes: Full name of the candidate. Candidate PII lives on this object only (design D2) — deleting the Application deletes this data.

cvFile.title: CV file
cvFile.x-notes: Reference (Nextcloud Files path or OpenRegister file id) to the uploaded CV, the Expense.receiptFile pattern.

motivation.title: Motivation
motivation.description: The candidate's motivation or cover letter.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this application has got to: new, screening, interview, offer or hired. It can be rejected at any active stage.
status.x-notes: Pipeline status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (nieuw -> screening -> gesprek -> aanbod -> aangenomen, afwijzen reachable from every active stage).

rejectedDate.title: Rejected date
rejectedDate.description: When the application was rejected. Empty unless it was.
rejectedDate.x-notes: Date the application was rejected, stamped on the afwijzen carrying write. Null on every non-afgewezen status.

talentPoolOptIn.title: Talent pool opt-in
talentPoolOptIn.description: The candidate agreed to be kept on file longer. This extends retention from four weeks to one year.
talentPoolOptIn.x-notes: Explicit candidate consent to extended talent-pool retention. Extends the retentionExpiryDate derivation from 4 weeks to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens maximum of 1 year.

retentionExpiryDate.title: Retention expiry date
retentionExpiryDate.description: When this application must be deleted: four weeks after rejection, or a year with the candidate's consent.
retentionExpiryDate.x-notes: Stored-but-rule-checked AVG retention deadline (design D4): rejectedDate + 4 weeks without talentPoolOptIn, or + 1 year with it (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn, AVG art. 5 lid 1 sub e). Checked by nl-ats-retentie-derivatie / nl-ats-retentie-verlopen. Null on every non-afgewezen status.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this application belongs to. Normally taken from the vacancy.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this Application is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); an Application has no employee (the candidate is not yet hired), so this is set from the vacancy's administratie when known, and nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema.

offerLetterFileId.title: Offer letter file id
offerLetterFileId.description: The generated offer letter. Filled in once the letter has been created.
offerLetterFileId.x-notes: offer-esign (0.3.0): the Nextcloud file id (File::getId()) of the generated aanbiedingsbrief PDF, stored via OpenRegister's FileService::addFile(). Null until OfferEsignService::requestSignature() successfully stores one.

offerSigningRequestId.title: Offer signing request id
offerSigningRequestId.description: The signing request for the offer letter. Filled in once signing has been started.
offerSigningRequestId.x-notes: offer-esign (0.3.0): the docudesk signing-request id returned by SigningService::createRequest(). A plain string, NOT a $ref -- docudesk owns a different register/app than the in-register $ref targets ADR-062 rule 7 governs (the GeneratedDocument.templateRef precedent). Null until a signing request has been created.

offerSigningStatus.title: Offer signing status
offerSigningStatus.description: Where signing the offer letter has got to. Separate from the application status: a signed offer does not move the pipeline on its own.
offerSigningStatus.x-notes: offer-esign (0.3.0): the offer letter's e-signature lifecycle state. The first six values are verbatim docudesk SigningService::STATUS_TRANSITIONS states (PENDING/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/DECLINED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED); skipped-no-docudesk and failed are this leaf's own duck-typed/failure outcomes. Null means no offer-esign attempt has been made yet. Orthogonal to Application.status -- observing COMPLETED here never advances the pipeline status (REQ-OFFR-006).

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: The candidate's answers to the vacancy's own questions, by question.
answers.x-notes: hiring-portal-audiences D3: keyed by Vacancy.questions[].key. Candidate data on the application, so it follows the application's retention clock.

Interview.title: Interview
Interview.description: One interview round (gesprek) scheduled for an Application (interview-scheduling design.md D2). A separate schema, not fields on Application, because a single Application can go through more than one interview round, each with its own lifecycle and calendar identity. InterviewCalendarService projects every scheduled Interview onto one configured shared Nextcloud calendar as a VEVENT (design.md D1/D3); calendarEventUid is the system-managed, stored idempotency marker set on first sync.

voltooien.description: The interview round has taken place. Terminal: the calendar event is kept as history and is no longer touched by the sync (design.md D4).

annuleren.description: The interview round is cancelled. Terminal: the next sync removes the calendar event (design.md D4); the Interview object itself is retained, not deleted.

applicationId.title: Application
applicationId.description: The application this interview belongs to.
applicationId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Application this interview round belongs to.

scheduledStart.title: Scheduled start
scheduledStart.description: When the interview starts. This is what goes in the calendar.
scheduledStart.x-notes: Start of the interview slot. Rendered as the VEVENT DTSTART by InterviewCalendarService.

scheduledEnd.title: Scheduled end
scheduledEnd.description: When the interview ends. This is what goes in the calendar.
scheduledEnd.x-notes: End of the interview slot. Rendered as the VEVENT DTEND by InterviewCalendarService.

interviewers.title: Interviewers
interviewers.description: Who will conduct the interview. Shown as plain text in the calendar item; no invitations are sent.
interviewers.x-notes: Free-text interviewer name(s). Rendered as plain DESCRIPTION text only — never as an ATTENDEE/ORGANIZER property, so no iMIP scheduling mail is ever triggered (design.md D5).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How the interview is conducted. Drives how 'location' is interpreted (a room for onsite, a phone number for phone, a call URL for video).

location.title: Location
location.description: The room, or the video-call link when the interview is online.
location.x-notes: Physical location/room, or a video-call URL when mode is 'video'. Rendered as the VEVENT LOCATION property.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this interview has got to: scheduled, completed or cancelled. Rescheduling just changes the times.
status.x-notes: Interview lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (scheduled -> completed/cancelled). Rescheduling is a plain field update to scheduledStart/scheduledEnd, not a status transition.

calendarEventUid.title: Calendar event UID
calendarEventUid.description: Links this interview to its calendar item. Managed automatically: do not edit.
calendarEventUid.x-notes: System-managed, never user-editable. Set by InterviewCalendarService on first successful sync (deterministic value hrmq-interview-{uuid}) and used on every later sync to look up and diff the existing calendar event, so a no-op resync writes nothing (design.md D3). Null means this Interview has never reached the calendar.

VacancyPosting.title: Vacancy posting
VacancyPosting.description: Where one vacancy stands on one job board: waiting, posted with the board's link, failed with the reason, or withdrawn. Written by the Vacature plaatsen and Vacature intrekken flows, one per vacancy and board (hiring-multiposting D3).

vacancyId.title: Vacancy
vacancyId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Vacancy. With channel the identity of a posting: the flows upsert on the pair.

channel.title: Job board
channel.description: The job board, by the code HR ticked on the vacancy.
channel.x-notes: A code from Vacancy.channels, the integriq source name.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the vacancy is waiting, on the board, failed or taken down.

externalId.title: Board reference
externalId.description: The board's own reference for the advert.
externalId.x-notes: Read from the board's answer by the source-call responseMapping; used to withdraw.

externalUrl.title: Link
externalUrl.description: Where the advert can be read on the board.

postedAt.title: Posted
postedAt.description: When the board accepted the advert.

withdrawnAt.title: Withdrawn
withdrawnAt.description: When the advert was taken down.

lastError.title: Reason it failed
lastError.description: Why the last attempt on this board failed.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The employer administration the vacancy belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Copied from the Vacancy by the flow.
